signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.intro: Authorised Confiance staff only. Every access is logged.
signIn.accountReady: Your account is ready. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.firstTimeBody: An administrator gave you an invite code: use it to create your password.
signIn.forgotten: Forgotten your password? Ask an administrator for a new invite code, then choose “Set up my account”.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.

enroll.title: Set up my account
enroll.intro: Enter your work email address, the invite code an administrator gave you, and the password you want to use.
enroll.codeHint: Dashes, spaces and capital letters do not matter.
enroll.ruleBytes: At most {{maxBytes}} bytes: an accented letter counts 2, some symbols 3 or 4 (currently {{bytes}})
enroll.ruleNotEmailName: Does not contain the part of your email before the @

notConfigured.title: Server not configured
notConfigured.body: This build of the dashboard has no Supabase settings (VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY). Tell the technical team.

noAccess.title: No staff access yet
noAccess.body: You are signed in as {{email}}, but this account has no active staff profile.
noAccess.next: Ask an administrator to activate your access, then sign in again.

copy.failed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it by hand.

testSession.title: Test sessions
testSession.intro: Creates a rider link to try the capture flow on a phone. The session is flagged as a test and the link expires after a few minutes.
testSession.qrLabel: QR code of the rider link
testSession.scan: Scan a QR code with the phone's camera, or send a link to the phone.
testSession.debugQrLabel: QR code of the debug link
testSession.debugHint: The debug link opens the same session, and the phone also shows its measurements and what it read from the code lines (✅/❌ for each check digit).
testSession.expired: This link has expired. Create a new test session.

recent.title: Recent verifications
recent.assignedOnly: You only see the verifications assigned to you.

case.title: Verification {{id}}
case.notFoundBody: This case does not exist or is not available to you.
case.linkUsed: No longer usable (case submitted or closed)
case.viewsLogged: Every photo view is recorded in the audit log. Each link works for 60 seconds.
case.photoRemoved: The link expired and the photo was removed from the page. Open it again if needed.
case.photoLoadFailed: The photo could not be loaded. The link may have expired: open it again.

serverChecks.title: Server checks
serverChecks.intro: Made on the server from the photos themselves, for the newest photo of each side. Anything marked provisional is not tuned on real documents yet: it is for information and never decides on its own.

document.title: Document recognised
document.pending: Not recognised yet: no photo of this case has a server result.

match.no: Does not match the declared document
match.unknown: Cannot tell whether it matches the declared document

reasons.title: For a person to decide
reasons.pending: No result from the server yet.
reasons.unknownOnly: Flagged for a reason this version of the dashboard cannot show. Reload the page.

label.mrz_unreadable_server: Code lines not read by the server
label.server_unchecked: Photo not checked by the server
label.mrz_print_mismatch: Printed text differs from the code lines

body.manual_review_document: This kind of document is always reviewed by a person: it has no code lines the server can check (old ID card, driving licence, voter card), or it is a residence permit or refugee card.
body.unsupported_document: The code lines show an ID card issued by another state, which is not accepted.
body.unrecognised_document: The server found neither code lines nor the printed title of an accepted document on the photos, so it could not tell what the document is.
body.type_mismatch: The code lines show another kind of document than the one the rider declared.
body.mrz_disagreement: The code lines the server read from the photo are not those read on the phone.
body.mrz_invalid_server: The server read code lines of the expected format on the photo, but a check digit, a date or the document code is wrong: the document may be damaged or altered. This holds even when the phone read the same lines.
body.mrz_unreadable_server: The server could not read code lines of the expected format on the photo.
body.phone_report_missing: The phone's reading of the code lines was not received, so the server's reading could not be compared with it.
body.provisional_classification: The document type was recognised from printed words only, not from code lines. This is provisional until tuned on real documents.
body.server_unchecked: The server could not check at least one photo (worker unavailable, daily budget reached, or only test sessions processed for now).
body.document_expired: The expiry date read from the code lines (or, without them, the printed one) has passed. Hard flag: never approved automatically.
body.under_18: From the birth date (code lines, otherwise printed), the holder is under 18 today. Hard flag: never approved automatically.
body.mrz_print_mismatch: A printed field does not match the code lines, after a tolerant comparison (accents, spaces, truncated names, look-alike characters). Compare with "Show data read".
body.date_logic: The code lines' dates contradict each other (birth after expiry).
body.number_format: The document number does not follow the format known for this document.

verdictBody.poor: A measure is outside the usual range (provisional limits, not tuned on real documents yet). The photo was kept and is not a reason on its own: compare it with the measures below.
verdictBody.no_document: The server found no document on this photo. The rider is asked to retake a photo at most once; this is the photo kept.
verdictBody.unreadable: The server found almost no text on this photo. The rider is asked to retake a photo at most once; this is the photo kept.

side.pending: No server result for this photo yet. It may still be in progress: refresh in a moment.
side.unchecked: The server could not check this photo (worker unavailable, daily budget reached, or only test sessions processed for now). A person reviews it.
side.notSent: This photo was taken before the server checks existed, so it was never sent to the server. A person reviews it.

mrz.title: Code lines read by the server
mrz.none: The server has no reading of the code lines for this photo.
mrz.found: Code lines found on the photo

phone.agrees: Same lines as read on the phone
phone.differs: Not the lines read on the phone
phone.phoneOnly: Read on the phone only: nothing to compare
phone.unreadable: Not readable on the phone: nothing to compare

fields.title: Printed text read
fields.found: Fields found: {{fields}}. Their values are behind “Show data read”.

consistency.title: Consistency

basis.mrz: From the code lines (firm), compared with the printed text.
basis.none: Nothing to compare: no code lines or printed text read.

consistency.provisionalBody: From the printed text, whose formats are not yet checked on real documents: for information, they decide nothing.

mrz.title: Code lines (MRZ)
mrz.intro: Read on the rider's phone. The server checked the lines again itself: the phone's own verdict is not used. What the server read from the photo itself is under “Server checks”.

expectedOn.document_front: This document carries its code lines on the front: {{format}}.
expectedOn.document_back: This document carries its code lines on the back: {{format}}.

mrz.optional: They are optional on this document: the rider was never asked to retake the photo for them.
mrz.none: This document has no code lines: nothing to read.
mrz.notReceivedBody: The phone sent no reading result for this photo.
mrz.noPhotoYet: No photo of this side yet.
mrz.detailsUnknown: The details of this result could not be read.

unreadable.not_found: Not readable on the phone: no code lines were found on the photo.
unreadable.reader_unavailable: Not readable on the phone: the reader could not run on it (old browser, or its files did not load).

checks.documentCode: Document code fits the declared document

mrz.unparsable: These lines could not be interpreted.

data.title: Data read from the document
data.intro: The code lines read on the phone and by the server, and the printed text read by the server.
data.logged: Every view of the data read is recorded in the audit log. It stays on screen for 60 seconds.
data.removed: The time was up and the data was removed from the page. Show it again if needed.
data.none: No data read from the document was stored for this case.

linesOf.mrz_phone: Code lines read on the phone: {{side}}
linesOf.mrz_server: Code lines read by the server: {{side}}

data.printedOf: Printed text read by the server: {{side}}

rawLines.mrz_phone: Lines as read by the phone
rawLines.mrz_server: Lines as read by the server

data.differencesMarked: (characters that differ from the other reading are highlighted)
data.printedNote: Read from the printed text, provisional: compare with the photo.

liveness.title: Face check
liveness.intro: The random challenge the server gave the rider and the frames their front camera took, with the capture check (whether the frames arrived complete and on time). The server's evaluation of the actions is in "Server face checks" below.
liveness.unreadable: The details of this check cannot be read by this version of the dashboard.
liveness.replaced_one: {{count}} frame of an earlier face check was replaced and erased.
liveness.replaced_other: {{count}} frames of earlier face checks were replaced and erased.

too_fast.title: Too fast.
too_fast.body: The frames cover less time than the actions need.

longer_than_challenge.title: Timing does not add up.
longer_than_challenge.body: The frames claim more time than passed on the server since the challenge was issued.

gap_too_long.title: Long pause.
gap_too_long.body: Several seconds passed between two frames.

out_of_order.title: Out of order.
out_of_order.body: Frame times or steps go backwards, or a frame does not fall in its step.

step_missing_frames.title: Missing frames.
step_missing_frames.body: A step has fewer frames than expected.

duplicate_frames.title: Identical frames.
duplicate_frames.body: Two frames are the same file.

frames_reused.title: Frame seen before.
frames_reused.body: A frame's file was already sent in another verification.

face.title: Server face checks
face.intro: The face worker's evaluation of the face check (test sessions; liveness on real sessions once the face switch is on) and the comparison of the ID portrait with the best frame (test sessions only). Every cut-off is a first guess: a person decides.
face.matchTitle: Face match: ID portrait and face check
face.uncalibratedBody: The threshold is a first guess, not yet set on Cameroonian faces (false matches are much more frequent for West Africans at a fixed threshold). This score never approves a case: compare the faces yourself.
face.waiting: Waiting for the face worker. Refresh in a moment.

notChecked.liveness: Not checked by the server (real sessions wait for the face switch, or the daily cap or the attempts ran out).
notChecked.faceMatch: Not compared: the face match runs on test sessions only, or the server gave up.

none.liveness: Not evaluated yet (no face check recorded).
none.faceMatch: Not compared yet (needs a face check and the document front).

face.unreadable: The details of this check cannot be read by this version of the dashboard.
face.livenessClean: Every action seen in its own step; nothing else to note.

action_not_done.title: Action not seen.
action_not_done.body: The face was seen during the step, but not doing what was asked.

wrong_direction.title: Wrong way.
wrong_direction.body: The head turned or tilted the other way than asked.

action_unclear.title: No face for an action.
action_unclear.body: No frame of a step showed exactly one face: the action could not be judged.

no_reference.title: No starting frame.
no_reference.body: No frame before the actions showed exactly one face: turns are measured from zero.

multiple_faces.title: Several faces.
multiple_faces.body: Some frames show more than one face.

face_jump.title: Possible cut.
face_jump.body: The face jumped between two frames (position or size): frames may come from different recordings.

flat_plane.title: Flat face.
flat_plane.body: When the head turned or tilted, the face moved like one flat picture (a print or a screen).

shape_change.title: Face shape changed.
shape_change.body: The face's 3-D shape differs from the first frame's: possibly another face.

moire.title: Screen pattern.
moire.body: A fine periodic pattern, as when a screen is filmed.

screen_glare.title: Glare on the face.
screen_glare.body: Part of the face is blown out white, as with a glossy print or a screen.

low_detail.title: Little detail.
low_detail.body: The face is unusually smooth, as with a re-photographed print.

portrait_not_found.title: No portrait found.
portrait_not_found.body: No face was found on the document photo: nothing was compared.

selfie_not_found.title: No usable frame.
selfie_not_found.body: No frame of the face check showed exactly one face: nothing was compared.

portrait_small.title: Small portrait.
portrait_small.body: The portrait on the document is very small: the score is less reliable.

detector_alignment.title: Rough alignment.
detector_alignment.body: The portrait was aligned without the face mesh: the score is less reliable.

selfie_not_frontal.title: Frame not straight.
selfie_not_frontal.body: The best frame does not face the camera: the score is less reliable.

face.sideBySideNote: Only the faces are shown; each photo opens for 60 seconds and each view is logged.
face.showBoth: Show the portrait and the frame (2 views)
face.selfieAlt: Best frame of the face check
face.photosGone: The document photo was replaced or erased.
face.uncalibratedCountedBody: The threshold is a first guess, not yet set on Cameroonian faces (false matches are much more frequent for West Africans at a fixed threshold). The active thresholds let a passed face match count toward an automatic approval (PM decision of 2026-10-20, test sessions only): compare the faces yourself.

errors.image_gone: This photo is no longer available.

errors.weak_password: This password is not accepted. Use between {{min}} and {{max}} characters and at most {{maxBytes}} bytes (an accented letter counts 2), without the part of your email before the @, and avoid common passwords.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_configured: This build has no server settings. Tell the technical team.
errors.enrollBadRequest: Check the email address and the invite code.
errors.testSessionRole: Only supervisors and administrators can create test sessions.
errors.adminNoImageAccess: Administrators have no routine access to ID images. A supervisor or the assigned reviewer can open them.
errors.photoNotFound: This photo is no longer available, or this case is not assigned to you.

errors.liveness_required: The face check is required first.
errors.too_many_challenges: Too many face checks for this session.
errors.challenge_expired: This face check expired or was replaced.
errors.challenge_used: This face check was already recorded.
errors.invalid_liveness: The face check's frames are not valid.
errors.already_decided: This case has already been decided. Reload the page.
errors.not_submitted: This case cannot be decided before the rider submits.
errors.note_required: A note is required for this decision.
errors.invalid_reason: Choose a reason for a reject (and none for an approval).
errors.stale_version: Someone saved a new version meanwhile. Reload the page and check the changes again.
errors.decisionRole: Your role does not allow deciding this case.

risk.title: Risk and decision
risk.intro: What the rules recommend from the checks, with every signal and its weight, and the threshold version used. Today a person decides every case.
risk.notAssessed: Not assessed yet. Reload in a moment.
risk.unknownShape: This assessment was stored by a newer version of the rules. Reload the page.

label.firm_score_high: Firm signals reach the reject cut-off

body.hard_flag: A hard flag is present: a person decides, whatever the score.
body.unknown_signal: A signal this version of the rules does not know: a person decides.
body.always_review_document: This kind of document is always decided by a person.
body.firm_score_high: The firm signals alone add up to {{rejectMin}} or more: the rules recommend a reject.
body.provisional_signals: The score reaches {{rejectMin}} only with provisional signals, which never reject: a person decides.
body.score_between: The score is above {{approveMax}} and under {{rejectMin}}: a person decides.
body.score_low: The score is {{approveMax}} or less: low enough to approve.
body.missing_checks: Some checks are missing (listed below): no approval until they exist.
body.review_only_check: The face match is not calibrated and this threshold version does not let it count: its result never helps approve a case (listed below).

risk.noSignals: No signal: nothing adds to the score.

signals.image_reused: Photo already used in another verification
signals.mrz_print_mismatch: Printed text differs from the code lines
signals.mrz_unreadable_server: Code lines not read by the server
signals.mrz_phone_flag: Phone's reading of the code lines flagged

missing.server_checks: Server checks of the photos (waiting, or not possible)

auto.title: Automatic approval
auto.approved: Approved automatically with threshold version {{version}} ({{at}}): every condition held.
auto.eligible: Every condition holds: the system approves this case.
auto.notAssessed: Not assessed for automatic approval (assessed before it existed).
auto.blocked: Not approved automatically: a person decides. Why:

blockers.auto_decide_off: Automatic approval is off in this threshold version
blockers.not_recommended: The rules do not recommend approval
blockers.document_not_firm: The document check is not firm (code lines with every check digit right)
blockers.mrz_print_mismatch: Printed text differs from the code lines
blockers.quality_not_ok: The server's photo check is missing or not ok
blockers.liveness_not_passed: Liveness check missing or not passed
blockers.face_match_not_passed: Face match missing or not passed
blockers.face_match_not_counted: The face match does not count in this threshold version

decision.title: Decision
decision.adminNoDecision: Administrators do not decide cases: a supervisor or the assigned reviewer does.
decision.noRecord: No decision record for this case.
decision.notSubmitted: Can be decided once the rider has submitted.

agreement.none: The recommendation was review: nothing to agree with.

decision.riderReasonHint: Shown to the rider in their language.

preview.disagrees: This goes against the recommendation: say why in the note.
preview.none: The rules leave this case to you.

decision.noteHint: For staff only, never shown to the rider. Required against the recommendation, or to approve a case with a hard flag. Do not copy data read from the document.
decision.checkAutomatic: The system approved this case on its own. Check it: confirm the approval, or reject it (a note is required to go against it).

thresholds.title: Decision thresholds
thresholds.intro: The rules' weights and cut-offs. A new version is active at once, without a redeploy: every case waiting for a decision is assessed again with it. Versions are never edited; each records who made it and why.
thresholds.saved_one: Version {{version}} is active. {{count}} case was assessed again.
thresholds.saved_other: Version {{version}} is active. {{count}} cases were assessed again.
thresholds.activeUnknown: The active version is in a format this dashboard does not know. Reload the page.
thresholds.editIntro: Weights and cut-offs are numbers from 0 to 1 with at most 4 decimals. The score adds the weights of the signals present (capped at 1).
thresholds.approveMaxHint: A score at or under this can be approved (only when no check is missing).
thresholds.rejectMinHint: Firm signals adding up to this or more recommend a reject. Provisional signals never reject.
thresholds.signalsCaption: Signals: weight, whether it counts, and whether it is a hard flag (always a person).
thresholds.alwaysReview: Documents always decided by a person
thresholds.autoDecideLabel: Approve automatically when every condition holds (never an automatic reject)
thresholds.autoDecideHint: Test sessions only. The system approves a case only when the document check is firm, nothing is expired or under age, no hard flag or firm signal, the photos, liveness and face match passed and the score is at or under the approve cut-off; anything else waits for a person. It never rejects.
thresholds.reasonHint: {{min}} to {{max}} characters, kept with the version.

change.notCounted: “{{signal}}” no longer counts in the score
change.notHard: “{{signal}}” is no longer a hard flag
change.notAlwaysReview: “{{document}}” no longer always decided by a person

thresholds.earlierFormat: Earlier format (before M8): every case went to a person.
thresholds.firstOfFormat: First version of the M8 rules.

errors.order: Must be above the approve cut-off.

thresholds.faceMatchCountsLabel: Let a passed face match count toward approval (uncalibrated)
thresholds.faceMatchCountsHint: The face match threshold is not calibrated on Cameroonian faces (NIST: about 14 times more false matches for West Africans at a default threshold), and its model is for test sessions only. Off: every face match is review-only again.
